acceptance.given: The candidate validator and its declared compatibility operation are available from the Toolchain package.

oracle.expected: An independent compatibility verification result is produced and records pass/fail separately from other validator checks.
forbidden: Compatibility is accepted without independent verification.
oracle.observable: The compatibility verification artifact contains a dedicated compatibility result with evidence of an independent check.

acceptance.then: The dedicated compatibility result is present and independently derived.
acceptance.when: Run the FR-3 compatibility validation against the candidate validator using the declared compatibility operation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Remove or bypass the dedicated compatibility verification and assert compatibility from another check; the validator must fail the independent-verification assertion.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add or preserve a separately observable compatibility verification result for FR-3, with no dependence on unrelated validator outcomes.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent schema change; reverting the compatibility-check implementation restores prior validator behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Independent verification pending -> dedicated compatibility verification result recorded.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The FR-3 compatibility check emits an independently derived result and the negative selector fails when that check is absent.

acceptance.given: The three named evaluation-seed occurrences and their provenance metadata are present in the Toolchain evaluation-seed manifest.

oracle.expected: Each named occurrence appears exactly once and has an approved, non-baseline classification.
forbidden: A named evaluation-seed occurrence lacks classification.
A named evaluation-seed occurrence is classified as baseline.
A named evaluation-seed occurrence has an unapproved classification.
oracle.observable: The manifest validation report lists all three named occurrences exactly once with approved non-baseline classifications.

acceptance.then: The evaluation-seed manifest passes classification validation for every named occurrence.
acceptance.when: Evaluate the FR-6 evaluation-seed manifest and its classification records.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Change one named occurrence to baseline, remove its classification, or use an unapproved label; manifest validation must fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce exact-once presence and approved non-baseline classification for each of the three named evaluation-seed occurrences.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Schema remains backward-compatible for valid manifests; rollback removes the stricter classification constraints.

slice_hint.state_transition: Unverified seed classifications -> all three occurrences classified approved and non-baseline.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Manifest validation reports exactly three named occurrences, each with an approved non-baseline classification, and the negative selector fails for missing, baseline, or unapproved classification.

acceptance.given: A reference coverage result and pinned evaluation inputs are available in version control.

oracle.expected: Running the evaluation from a fresh checkout with the pinned inputs produces a coverage result byte-for-byte equal to the reference coverage result.
forbidden: The fresh-checkout coverage result differs from the reference coverage result.
The result cannot be reproduced from the pinned inputs.
oracle.observable: The replay report records the fresh-checkout coverage result and an equality comparison to the pinned reference result.

acceptance.then: The fresh-checkout replay is reproducible and its coverage result matches the reference.
acceptance.when: Create a clean checkout, restore pinned inputs, execute the coverage evaluation, and compare its result with the reference artifact.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Alter a pinned input or reference coverage result so the fresh-checkout replay differs; the replay validator must fail deterministically.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make fresh-checkout replay capture and compare the computed coverage result against the pinned reference using deterministic inputs.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Replay output format remains compatible; rollback restores prior evaluation execution without the reproducibility comparison.

slice_hint.state_transition: Reference and pinned inputs available -> fresh-checkout replay result equals reference coverage result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The fresh-checkout run emits a coverage result and equality assertion against the pinned reference; the altered-input selector produces a deterministic failure.

acceptance.given: Frozen historical artifacts have established byte contents before repair or runtime operations.

oracle.expected: A before/after byte-level comparison confirms identical bytes for every frozen historical artifact while new evidence is appended only within declared boundaries.
forbidden: The contents or byte representation of a frozen historical artifact changes.
oracle.observable: The preservation check reports matching hashes or byte comparisons for every frozen historical artifact.

acceptance.then: All frozen historical artifact bytes remain unchanged after the operation.
acceptance.when: Run repair or runtime operations, then perform the declared before/after byte-level comparison over the frozen historical artifact set.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Modify one frozen historical artifact during the operation; the byte-preservation comparison must fail and identify the changed artifact.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Preserve frozen historical artifact bytes and verify their before/after hashes while allowing only declared evidence appends.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No schema or historical artifact migration; rollback restores the prior preservation check behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Frozen historical bytes established -> post-operation byte comparison confirms unchanged bytes.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The preservation validator reports equal before/after bytes for every frozen artifact and fails when any frozen artifact is changed.
